materials: Matching SDCC, CMake and Ninja source archives are delivered as Release assets, including build scripts and retained per-file licenses.
Selected executable bytes are unchanged from the pinned official binary archives.
No local STC headers or backup directories, non-free PIC tree, CMake Qt GUI, SDCC debugger/simulator or standalone third-party DLLs are included.
The 11 selected SDCC PE executables, including cc1, import only Windows platform DLLs.
Static GCC runtime attribution and Runtime Library Exception are retained; SDCC, preprocessor and binutils corresponding source remains required and is delivered.
Original CMake bundled dependency notices are retained; additional Boost, MinGW-w64 and Ninja notices are delivered in both component and source supplement.
limitations: Validation is offline import and MCS-51 build only; no hardware, flashing or debugging approval.
Recipe reproduces component assembly; no claim of bit-identical upstream source recompilation.
Supplemental MinGW-w64 attribution collection is not proof of the exact upstream build environment.
Old 1.0.0 component bytes and project locks are unchanged.
